info.description: The Loyalty Partners Retrieval API allows businesses to access a curated list of loyalty partners associated with their loyalty program. This API is designed for platforms seeking to enhance customer engagement by displaying potential loyalty partners. Developers can retrieve detailed information regarding each partner, enabling integration into user interfaces or promotional campaigns. Typical consumers include loyalty program managers and marketing teams aiming to leverage partnerships for increased customer retention.
